title: MCA Result Portal
description: Built and deployed a public portal for the MCA 2024–2026 batch. Classmates can view semester-wise SGPA scores and rankings; the portal also serves the batch tutors.

title: Zane’s Optimizer
description: A desktop app that arranges input images on PDF pages to reduce wasted paper, helping students prepare projects, assignments, and records.

title: Rapid-Prototype GUI Applications
description: A set of functional GUI prototypes created for class programming challenges, including a calculator and a Linux user-management tool.

title: Stock Price Prediction with ML
description: A command-line tool that uses historical stock data to predict next-day prices. The dataset is updated daily and the model is retrained.
